name: Default
description: As it opens: Amount 30%, no points, the curve flat at 100% (it follows Amount everywhere).

name: In use
description: Amount 55%, three points: less in the lows, more around 3 kHz and 9.5 kHz.

name: Amount, hover
description: The ticks darken and the value turns into a chip.

name: Amount, drag
description: The pointer dot grows while you drag. The ring thins as the value rises.

name: Small knob, hover
description: The outline thickens and the value turns into a chip.

name: Small knob, drag
description: Restore being dragged.

name: Shape, drag
description: A ring around the thumb while it's held. Both ends show their share.

name: Switch, hover
description: The segment under the pointer gets a thin outline.

name: Point, hover
description: The point grows, shows its width bracket and a readout.

name: Point, drag
description: Filled, with a halo, a drop line to the frequency scale and the readout.

name: Point, selected
description: Stays filled with its bracket and readout after you let go. Scroll on it to change the width.

name: Six points
description: The most there can be. Double-clicking empty space says so.

name: Delta on
description: Only what's removed plays. The removed part turns heavy and klein; the result drops to a hairline.

name: Clean
description: Transparent: the gentler range.

name: Character
description: Goes further: the same settings take out more.

name: HQ
description: Full resolution, with latency. One curve.

name: Live
description: No latency. Your curve turns dashed; the smoothed curve that's applied is drawn solid.

name: Bypassed
description: Nothing thins: one heavy line, no hatching, the curve and the value arcs fade.

name: No signal
description: The analyser is empty; the curve stays.

name: Tooltip
description: After 600 ms over a control. Ink box, paper text.

name: Tooltip on a point
description: How to use a point, once.

name: At 75%
description: 720 × 450, the smallest size.

name: At 200%
description: 1920 × 1200, the largest size.

name: Redlines
description: Every element's position and size, in window pixels at 100%.
